summary: Gabriel Max Baldonado of Albuquerque vanished near West Fork Road (FSR 648) below the Wolf Creek Pass overlook; his functional 2014 Toyota Camry was found Aug 13, 2020 piled under a slash pile of logs, with a stick pentagram ~300 ft away. A Mineral County SO search with human-remains dogs found nothing; later hitchhiker sightings suggested he may have been alive en route to New Mexico.
location: West Fork Road (FSR 648), below Wolf Creek Pass overlook
notes: MERGE note run970: date is the car-find date (Thursday 2020-08-13); disappearance itself unpinned within ~10 days prior per the West Fork Campground host; Baldonado remained unlocated as of Sept-2020 Herald reporting, with possible hitchhiker sightings south toward the NM state line. DGO feature cites Durango Herald reporting.
